traits.note: Abrams and Ferris's Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States, volume 4 (1960), read in full: corolla funnelform, 5-lobed and obscurely two-lipped, 2.5 to 3.5 cm long; calyx inflated, deeply two-lipped; stamens 4, the fifth a rudimentary filament.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris, Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States vol. 4 (1960), Bignoniaceae, Chilopsis: a shrub with simple leaves, usually alternate, unlike the family's opposite ones.
